placements.why: The Pallasine checklist is an organizational onboarding process — a mandatory procedure governing how new hires are integrated into the institution. No existing strata category exists; this envelope's content calls for an organizational tier to hold it.
placements.title: Organizational Process and Structure
placements.frame: What organizational processes, roles, and structures govern how work is done?

placements.title: From Wiki to Structured Checklist as Mandatory Onboarding
placements.frame: How is the Pallasine checklist established as the mandatory first-week onboarding process, and what institutional system did it replace?
placements.why: Both segments cohere under the theme of the Pallasine checklist as the institutional onboarding standard. src-1 performs the universal mandate — every new hire, first week, three named components (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) — at decision-grade conviction, while src-2 grounds the checklist's authority through institutional supersession of the old wiki page last quarter. No existing leaf holds this theme; the grain test admits it as a subject future envelopes will keep feeding (onboarding components, enforcement, evolution).
